  "description": "Hello Products is an African personal and home care company based in Lagos State, Nigeria and a member of Jagal Investments. We develop, manufacture and distribute a range of high quality personal and home care products that support a healthier life and safer homes throughout Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mechanical Technician

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Perform installation and commissioning of new machinery and equipment in accordance with manufacturer and company specifications.
	Carry out preventive, condition-based, and breakdown maintenance on all mechanical equipment.
	Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical systems, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum operational reliability.
	Perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions for mechanical faults.
	Analyze data and equipment performance records to identify areas for improvement and optimize machine efficiency.
	Ensure accurate documentation of maintenance activities, machine safety checks, and repair records.
	Collaborate closely with controllers, engineers, and production teams to address mechanical issues and improve system performance.
	Maintain strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards during all maintenance and repair work.
	Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives within the maintenance department.


Requirements


	HND/B.Sc in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in mechanical maintenance, preferably in FMCG.
	Proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving mechanical faults.

	Perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions for mechanical faults.
	Analyze data and equipment performance records to identify areas for improvement and optimize machine efficiency.
	Ensure accurate documentation of maintenance activities, machine safety checks, and repair records.
	Collaborate closely with controllers, engineers, and production teams to address mechanical issues and improve system performance.
	Maintain strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards during all maintenance and repair work.
	Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives within the maintenance department.


Requirements


	HND/B.Sc in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in mechanical maintenance, preferably in FMCG.
	Proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving mechanical faults.

        Hello Products is an African personal and home care company based in Lagos State, Nigeria, and a member of Jagal Investments. We develop, manufacture, and distribute a range of high-quality personal and home care products that support a healthier life and safer homes throughout Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Executive

	Drive the growth and expansion of the beauty care channel for Hello Products Limited.

	Bachelor's Degree or HND in a related field (Social Sciences, Management Sciences, or similar).
	A minimum of 2 to 3 years of sales experience within the FMCG industry is preferred.
	Proven experience in sales within the cosmetics or beauty industry is essential.
	Strong digital presence with an extensive social media network to engage and influence potential clients.
